INNER JOIN ( SELECT E.CMPNY_CD, E.SITE_CD, E.SCH_CD, E.APPLY_DATE , E.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, E.FST_SCH_END_TIME, E.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , E.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, E.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, E.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN FROM ( SELECT M.CMPNY_CD, M.SITE_CD, M.SCH_CD, M.APPLY_DATE , M.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, M.FST_SCH_END_TIME, M.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , M.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, M.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, M.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , 2147483647 AS HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT H.CMPNY_CD, H.SITE_CD, H.SCH_CD, H.APPLY_DATE , H.FST_SCH_STR_TIME, H.FST_SCH_END_TIME, H.FST_SCH_BRK_MIN , H.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME, H.SEC_SCH_END_TIME, H.SEC_SCH_BRK_MIN , H.HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H WHERE H.USE_YN = 'Y' ) E WHERE E.HIST_IDX = ( SELECT MAX(E2.HIST_IDX) FROM ( SELECT M2.CMPNY_CD, M2.SITE_CD, M2.SCH_CD, M2.APPLY_DATE, 2147483647 AS HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M2 WHERE M2.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT H2.CMPNY_CD, H2.SITE_CD, H2.SCH_CD, H2.APPLY_DATE, H2.HIST_IDX FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H2 WHERE H2.USE_YN = 'Y' ) E2 WHERE E2.CMPNY_CD = E.CMPNY_CD AND E2.SITE_CD = E.SITE_CD AND E2.SCH_CD = E.SCH_CD AND E2.APPLY_DATE = E.APPLY_DATE ) ) SC ON SC.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND SC.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND SC.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD AND SC.APPLY_DATE = (
SELECT COALESCE( MAX(CASE WHEN SE.APPLY_DATE <= WP.WORK_YMD THEN SE.APPLY_DATE END) , MIN(SE.APPLY_DATE) ) FROM ( SELECT M3.CMPNY_CD, M3.SITE_CD, M3.SCH_CD, M3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT M3 WHERE M3.USE_YN = 'Y' UNION ALL SELECT H3.CMPNY_CD, H3.SITE_CD, H3.SCH_CD, H3.APPLY_DATE FROM TB_SCH_MGMT_HIST H3 WHERE H3.USE_YN = 'Y' ) SE WHERE SE.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND SE.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND SE.SCH_CD = WP.WORK_PLAN_CD )

/* AttdReminderMapper.selectCheckInTargets */ SELECT T.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , T.SITE_CD AS siteCd , T.USER_CD AS userCd , T.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , T.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq FROM (
SELECT WP.CMPNY_CD, WP.SITE_CD, WP.USER_CD, U.NODE_CD, 1 AS WORK_SEQ FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP
INNER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND U.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND U.USER_CD = WP.USER_CD WHERE WP.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND SC.FST_SCH_STR_TIME = #{targetHhmm} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' UNION ALL
SELECT WP.CMPNY_CD, WP.SITE_CD, WP.USER_CD, U.NODE_CD, 2 AS WORK_SEQ FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP
INNER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND U.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND U.USER_CD = WP.USER_CD WHERE WP.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND NULLIF(TRIM(SC.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME), '') IS NOT NULL AND SC.SEC_SCH_STR_TIME = #{targetHhmm} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' ) T WHERE NOT EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE L WHERE L.CMPNY_CD = T.CMPNY_CD AND L.SITE_CD = T.SITE_CD AND L.USER_CD = T.USER_CD AND L.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND L.DEL_YN = 'N' AND L.USE_UNIT_TYPE = '00' AND L.START_DATE <= #{workYmd} AND L.END_DATE >= #{workYmd} ) AND NOT EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = T.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = T.SITE_CD AND A.USER_CD = T.USER_CD AND A.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND A.WORK_SEQ = T.WORK_SEQ AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' )

/* AttdReminderMapper.selectCheckOutTargets */ SELECT WP.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , WP.SITE_CD AS siteCd , WP.USER_CD AS userCd , U.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(SC.SEC_SCH_END_TIME), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS workSeq FROM TB_USER_WORK_PLAN WP
INNER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND U.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND U.USER_CD = WP.USER_CD INNER JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_MGMT A ON A.CMPNY_CD = WP.CMPNY_CD AND A.SITE_CD = WP.SITE_CD AND A.USER_CD = WP.USER_CD AND A.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND A.WORK_SEQ = CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(SC.SEC_SCH_END_TIME), '') IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE WP.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' AND ( CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(SC.SEC_SCH_END_TIME), '') IS NOT NULL THEN SC.SEC_SCH_END_TIME ELSE SC.FST_SCH_END_TIME END ) = #{targetHhmm} AND NULLIF(TRIM(A.CHECK_IN_TIME), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(A.CHECK_OUT_TIME), '') IS NULL
